name: Text React
description: Hold a message, tap Text React, type some text and it is added to the message as reactions: letters become emoji letters, digits become keycaps, and words like ok, cool and 100 have an emoji of their own.
author: MarkLong0467 (https://github.com/MarkLong0467 "GitHub")
